'''Bairn''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], born and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]] about [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].

==Biography==
Bairn was one of several youths who assisted [[Tenno]] steal a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] from the community elders after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed near their village. When the elders met to debate the matter of the holocron, Tenno and his friends armed themselves and appeared at the meeting. A brawl broke out, in which several of the adults were killed. The fight was interrupted by the appearance of a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], who seized the holocron and departed. When Tenno tried to explain that he and his friends had kept the artifact safe for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the Sith Lord attacked and killed several of them with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
